declarations.name: re_logDeriv_riemannZeta_criticalLine_neg
declarations.doc: Speiser's sign law.** Above height `20`, `Re(ζ'/ζ) < 0` on the critical line wherever `ζ ≠ 0`.

declarations.name: riemannZeta_criticalLine_eq_zero_of_deriv_eq_zero
declarations.doc: Critical points on the critical line are multiple zeros.** Above height `20`, a zero of `ζ'` on the line is a zero of `ζ`.

declarations.name: critical_mem_of_derivative_eq_zero
declarations.doc: The listed critical points are all of them.** A degree-`n+1` polynomial has at most `n` critical points, so `n` distinct listed ones exhaust the roots of the derivative.

declarations.name: zetaChiDisplacedCriticalRatioDeriv
declarations.doc: Exact derivative field of the slow displaced-to-critical chi ratio.

declarations.name: eVariationOn_le_of_no_critical_points
declarations.doc: Variation bound from a critical-point-free partition.** An ordered partition whose cells carry no critical point is a monotonicity partition, so the finite-monotonicity law applies.

declarations.name: smoothAFEZetaSquareDualDerivativeSourceField
declarations.doc: Literal source derivative field, retaining divisor multiplicity and critical phase.

declarations.name: fixed_points_eq_of_not_criticalOrbitAvoidingTarget
declarations.doc: If two fixed points both fail the critical-orbit avoidance condition, then they are the same fixed point.

declarations.name: eVariationOn_le_of_no_interior_critical_points
declarations.doc: Variation bound from a partition whose open cells are critical-point free.** This is the form the Sturm cell count supplies: critical points are allowed at the partition points themselves, which is exactly where they sit.

declarations.name: smoothAFEZetaSquareDualDerivativeNatCoefficient
declarations.doc: Positive-integer reindexing retaining the full critical Dirichlet phase.

declarations.name: criticalFullLogResponse_add_target_eq_derivative
declarations.doc: Exact arithmetic cancellation identifies the critical response with the normalized zeta derivative.

declarations.name: centeredPrimeTailGaugeDerivative_eq_zeta_sampling_error
declarations.doc: Away from the removed pole, the entire gauge derivative is the usual zeta sampling error.

declarations.name: logDeriv_riemannZeta_add_reflect_criticalLine
declarations.doc: Reflection formula on the critical line.** At `s = 1/2 + it` the reflection `1 - s` is `1/2 - it`, so the identity becomes a relation between the two conjugate points of the line and the two conjugate archimedean modes.

declarations.name: fixed_points_mem_positiveCriticalOrbit_eq
declarations.doc: The positive critical orbit cannot contain two distinct fixed points. Once the critical orbit reaches one fixed point, every later fixed-point occurrence must be the same point.

declarations.name: experimentalQubit_derivativeCrossNumerator
declarations.doc: Exact critical polynomial of the experimental map, exposing its two fixed critical points.

declarations.name: derivative_ne_zero_of_notMem
declarations.doc: Off the listed critical points the derivative does not vanish.

declarations.name: natSucc_mul_norm_smoothAFEZetaSquareDualDerivativeCoefficient_sq_eq
declarations.doc: Critical amplitude cancellation: the affine `n`-weighted mass is exactly the phase-free divisor-square derivative mass.

declarations.name: norm_zetaUpperBlaschkeSelectedLogDerivativeSummand_imaginary_le_inverseSquare
declarations.doc: On the safe imaginary axis, every selected Blaschke summand has a height-uniform inverse-square ordinate majorant. The constant `4` follows only from the critical-strip bound `|Im alpha| < 1/2` and `v > 1`.

exploration.name: exists_polynomial_critical_packet
exploration.doc: Finite critical-packet interpolation.** Given distinct points, nonzero function values, and prescribed derivative values, one polynomial has value `1` at every point and makes the formal product-rule derivative vanish there.

exploration.name: energy_eq_neg_second_derivative
exploration.doc: (E1), the energy identity** at critical points: `Σ_{r ∈ s} (c − r)⁻² = −P″(c)/P(c)`, stated division-free.

exploration.name: norm_zetaFunctionalFactor_critical
exploration.doc: Unit modulus of the zeta functional factor on the critical line.** `‖2 (2π)^{−(1/2 − iy)} Γ(1/2 − iy) cos(π(1/2 − iy)/2)‖ = 1`.

exploration.name: not_memLp_riemannZeta_criticalLine
exploration.doc: Zeta is not square integrable on the critical line.**
